_notes: required_for_profiles is advisory, non-operative metadata in v0.1. The validator does NOT read or enforce it. It is a human-facing hint only. To actually mandate a code for a profile, add it to that profile manifest's required_machine_limitation_codes list; enforcement is driven exclusively by the manifest, never by this field. See migration.md.
